QuestInfo.name: [9th Anniversary Par-tay] 30 Minute Favor
QuestInfo.0: A party isn't a party without party favors! Cassandra has prepared gifts for the party.
QuestInfo.1: You'll be able to open the gift box Cassandra gave you in 30 minutes. #rIf you log out before the time is up, the gift will disappear and you will have to start all over#k. So make sure you don't log out!
QuestInfo.2: You opened Cassandra's Gift Box and got an awesome gift!

default.0: Talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park after you open the gift!

npc.0: Go talk to Inkie at the 9th Anniversary Park. You can use the Dimensional Mirror or the Teleport Rock that I gave you.
